data.assumption: “Share of Chennai orders cancelled last month” means cancelled orders divided by all non-test Chennai orders with business dates in August 2026.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(o.status) = 'cancelled')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN cities c ON c.city_id = s.city_id
WHERE o.is_test IS FALSE
  AND c.name = 'Chennai'
  AND o.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND o.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
